notablePrerequisites:
Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
description:
Activate Myr Welder by tapping it, exiling Staff of Domination from your graveyard.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder by tapping it, exiling Metalworker from your graveyard.
Activate Myr Welder using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Metalworker's ability by tapping it, revealing artifact cards from your hand, adding {C}{C} for each artifact cards revealed.
Repeat from step 4.
